## Problem

Explain the user-visible problem and why it matters. Link the relevant issue or decision.

## Change and resulting behavior

Describe what changes, the affected surfaces, and how users or operators experience the result.

## Verification

List the actual commands or manual scenarios run, their results, and any untested behavior. Include environment/version details when they affect the result. Add screenshots for material UI changes.

## Compatibility and rollout

State any API, schema, configuration, permission, dependency, or migration change. Explain rollout and rollback when applicable; use “Not applicable” with a reason for small changes.

## Reviewer notes

Identify decisions needing review, known limitations, and any follow-up work. Do not include credentials, customer data, or unpublished vulnerability details.
